write_up: This is a strong payments resume! Your work at Lumen Ledger connects the services you built to payout volume, a zero-downtime migration, and a faster balance API. A recruiter can see why your backend experience fits money movement.

The payouts service line is a model for the rest: it names what you built, the stack, and how much it handles. The recent roles are especially concrete; the older Northgate work has less detail, but it doesn't obscure your current level.

For Cobalt Pay, lead with the payouts and ledger work. Add any real experience with on-call ownership, leading design reviews, or working with Finance and Risk on reconciliation and controls. Your resume isn't likely to be the reason you don't get a callback; competition for the role and how closely your experience matches its remaining requirements also matter.
